date: Nov 11, 2026 · Week 1 / Day 3 · Visibility & early risk communication

cards.title: Headline the exposure, not the activity
cards.question: A PCIe Gen5 channel has only 0.6 dB margin before signoff. What goes first in your update?
cards.selfCheck: Lead with the margin at risk, confidence and signoff date; put simulation work second. Exercise: deliver a 20-second update ending with the decision owner.
cards.prompt: Coach me through a 20-second risk-first status update for a PCIe Gen5 channel with 0.6 dB margin before signoff. Critique decision clarity.

cards.title: Give uncertainty an expiration date
cards.question: EM and TDR disagree on a connector launch. How do you avoid an open-ended investigation?
cards.selfCheck: State competing explanations and a discriminating measurement, with owner and due date. Exercise: say 'not yet proven' without sounding passive.
cards.prompt: Role-play a review where TDR and EM disagree at a connector launch. Help me state confidence, a decisive test, owner and deadline.

cards.title: Own the handoff, not just your model
cards.question: A PDN resonance may amplify a processor transient, but package and VRM teams own parts of the path. Who drives closure?
cards.selfCheck: Name a single system-level risk owner and agree on VRM/package/board evidence. Exercise: request a cross-team checkpoint before the design gate.
cards.prompt: Help me lead cross-functional closure of a PDN resonance involving VRM, package and board teams without formal authority.

cards.title: Present two viable paths
cards.question: A crosstalk fix improves isolation but delays layout freeze. What does leadership need?
cards.selfCheck: Show option A/B with SI margin, schedule cost, residual risk and decision deadline. Exercise: recommend one path while naming what would reverse your choice.
cards.prompt: Challenge my two-option recommendation for crosstalk mitigation versus layout freeze. Make me quantify residual risk and schedule impact.

cards.title: Close the loop in one minute
cards.question: Yesterday you warned about a via stub; today its impact is uncertain. What update earns trust?
cards.selfCheck: Report what changed, what remains unknown, the next test and exact checkpoint. Exercise: write a three-sentence update for SI, layout and PM.
cards.prompt: Quiz me on a three-sentence follow-up after an early via-stub risk escalation. Critique confidence, ownership and next checkpoint.
